title: Pass the behaviour in
hints: A parameter declared `int (*f)(int)` is called just like a normal function: `f(x)`.
`map_ints` is a single loop that overwrites each element with `f(arr[i])`. `fold_ints` keeps a running `acc` that starts at `init` and becomes `combine(acc, arr[i])` for each element in order.
`int acc = init; for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) acc = combine(acc, arr[i]); return acc;` With `n == 0` the loop never runs, so you return `init` and never call `combine`.
